summary: Exotel real-call flow (READY mode) — Backend 13/13 PASSED, Frontend modal flow PASSED. ONE real Exotel call was placed to +919008136500 via POST /api/voice/exotel/call and Exotel returned an honest response with a session_ref, provider_call_sid, http_status and no credentials in the body. GET /api/voice/exotel/status returns state=READY, verified=true, and NO secret values leak (subdomain only). /call requires auth (401), returns 404 for bogus mission/vendor, and normalizes 9008136500 -> +919008136500 in the stored voice session. Session tracking works: GET /api/voice/exotel/session/{ref} returns the doc for the owning org, 401 unauthenticated, 404 for bogus ref. Safety: after the call, offers count for the mission was unchanged and mission status was NOT moved to APPROVED/COMPLETED. Webhook path (mocked): session-end with wrong token -> 401; with valid token + CustomField + CallStatus=completed + DialCallDuration=42 -> 'recorded' and the session then shows status='completed' + duration='42'; duplicate identical POST -> 'duplicate'. session-start returns read-only authority (max_price_per_unit=1000, target=900); posting max_price_per_unit=999999 did NOT mutate stored authority. Audit: mission events include 'call_started' and 'call_ended' and NO Exotel api_key/api_token/account_sid values leak into any audit detail. Frontend: from mission detail, per-vendor button data-testid=exotel-call-{vendorId} opens data-testid=exotel-call-modal which shows Mission title, Vendor name, exotel-destination pre-filled with 9008136500, the 'never create an offer/order/purchase/approval' safety note, and an exotel-confirm-call button. No secret keywords found in modal DOM. Confirm was intentionally NOT clicked in the FE test to honor the 'only ONE real call' constraint (already exercised by backend).
critical_code_review_comments: exotel_service.live_status caches verify_credentials for 60s — good for perf, but consider a small jitter and log at INFO when transitioning READY<->INVALID_CREDENTIALS so operators see credential drift.

place_outbound_call return value uses `node` in the ok branch and `parsed` in the not-ok branch; the local var `node` is only defined when JSON parsing succeeded, so the current code is correct. Worth extracting into a small helper for readability.

ExotelCallModal.js poll interval never stops if the modal is closed mid-call — clearInterval only fires on unmount via useEffect cleanup. Verified cleanup runs on unmount, so no leak. Minor: consider aborting the poll on onClose to avoid a final 3s tick.
Frontend defaultNumber is hard-coded to '9008136500' in MissionDetail.js — fine for this test flow but should be replaced with vendor.contact_phones[0] in production or made configurable per org.

Session GET endpoint returns entire voice_sessions doc (including 'authority', 'reported_offer', 'to', etc). It excludes _id but does include organization_id in the doc — not a secret, but consider filtering to the fields the UI actually needs.
The /call endpoint returns http_status even when Exotel returns e.g. 4xx trial-account rejections. This is honest and required for UI to display 'not accepted' state — good.
